description: tk-studio Epic 29 (One Account, the Registry, the Projection) through the supervisor's queue (declared 2026-10-17 with the epic). Extends the shipped run-epic type: one-shot; the first launch bootstraps the spec folder _bmad-output/specs/spec-epic-29 and the manifest from epics.md and commits them on the run branch (Story 26.1). Submit it with POST /jobs {project: tk-studio, job: run-epic-29} (its placement, tier sbx on claude-tk-studio, in TK_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG); the run's worktree is cut from main, tools/verify_host.py is the host verify leg, bun test from apps/supervisor is the dev session's own gate, and the close-out opens the PR. The supervisor tab keeps running: the engine edits the worktree, never the checkout.
